newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Lira to observe 15 pct band in ERM - statement.
newsitem.headline: Lira to observe 15 pct band in ERM - statement.

text.p: The Italian lira will observe the 15 percent fluctuation bands within the Exchange Rate mechanism (ERM), which it entered at the parity rate of 990 to the mark, A EU statement said.
It said the EU, which on Sunday approved lira's return to ERM after four years of absence, congratulated Italy on the "substantial adjustments already achieved by the Italian economy".
The statement said all other bilateral rates within the ERM remained unchanged.
The EU also said the lira entry into ERM confirmed its commitment to long term convergence of European economies that would help the creation of a joint European currency.

"The ministers, the governors, the commission and the European Monetary Institute warmly welcome the resumption of the lira's full participation in the ERM, which strengthens the European Monetary System," the statement said.
